data.name: SpessVR
data.detailed_description:
Inspired by Space Station 13. Experience the chaos in VR or PC/Desktop mode!

Live a life on a Space Station, grow plants, mutate them into new types of plants, mix different chemical reagents, and when you are ready, get out and explore outer space to acquire wealth by mining minerals on asteroids. Make sure to defend NanoTrasen:tm: station against Syndicate armed threat... or just don't, it's up to you.

Features:

  • Botany - Harvest and evolve your plants into powerful and newer species. Turn tomato into irradiated bluespace tomato, yum. Side effects may include teleportation into space or station walls.

  • Chemistry - Make different chemical reagents for your own use. Make fertilizers for plants, or things that explode because that is funny.

  • Mining - Collect minerals, a lot of minerals preferably... Dump all your minerals at cargo, build up your fortune in this final frontier.

  • Cooking - Take ingredients you just grew yourself or ones you found in questionable parts of the station. Make custom shaped pizzas, burgers out of your favourite ingredients (such as deepfried berries) and more.

  • Multiplayer - Full voice chat cross platform (PC and VR) multiplayer. It is not easy being cramped in this metal death can together, but what is life without a little chaos?

  • Physically Simulated player bodies, including knock down, broken limbs, fatigue and other bodily states.

  • Procedural Persistent Stations. Complete loss of one station will allow you to respawn in another, fresh, randomly generated space station. How long will this one last? Only one way to find out.

    And more to come.

    Join our Discord for suggestions and community discussions!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Later
  • Processor: Dual Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Later
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 3.3 GHz or Better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or Better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Spess can be played with or without VR devices with equal support and features.
